title: Sources: Jensen Huang has discussed a comeback as Nvidia CEO with confidants, as allies form a "war room" to lobby for his return and seek White House support (Financial Times)
summary: Financial Times: Sources: Jensen Huang has discussed a comeback as Nvidia CEO with confidants, as allies form a “war room” to lobby for his return and seek White House support — Tech supporters lobby chipmaker's board to reinstate former CEO after he resigned following affair with alleged Chinese spy
